boundary.description: From the junction of Esther Street and Greenacres Road, E along Greenacres Road and then by Saddleworth civil parish boundary to the SE border of Waterhead Academy and by a bee-line E to the Saddleworth civil parish boundary by Hollins Avenue, and by that boundary (which is also diocesan boundary) to the junction of Hartshead Street and South Hill. W by Thornley Brook to Holt Lane and by a bee-line N, then W to Roundthorn Road (excluding all of Ferndale Close and Coverham Avenue estate). Then N by Roundthorn Road, Brewerton Road, Clarksfield Road and Esther Street to its junction with Greenacres Road.
